Boogie Woogie — Innate Technique (11th level)

When you reach 11th level, you have understood the true depths of Boogie Woogie, your Boogie gains the following:

  • Your range increases to 60 feet

  • When you switch places with an ally who was previously in melee range of an enemy right before the switch, your next attack roll has advantage, the same goes if you teleport an enemy into range or an ally into range.

  • You can use Boogie on up to four creatures at once.
